quests.title: The Right to Roam
quests.summary: Ezra Hollins wants the 1932 Kinder trespass remembered properly, and the High Moor open to everyone who wants to walk it.

steps.text: Join the Ramblers at the Keswick guest house, then tell Ezra at Goyt Valley.
Find the tin box somebody hid in the Blue John caves at Castleton.
Meet Hilda Pickles in York or Leeds and ask after the Clarion minute book, then tell Ezra.
Take the tin and the minutes to the Footpaths Officer at Manchester Town Hall.
Buy the Saddleworth High Moor lease at auction, then tell Ezra.
Mend the keepers' wall on the High Moor with the waller.
Face the Enclosure's agent at the keepers' hut on the High Moor.
Show the curlew counter a mountain hare.
Meet the walker at the old gate on the High Moor at dawn.
Report back to Ezra in Goyt Valley.

quests.reward: The Right of Way Boots charm, Bakewell puddings, flasks of tea, standing in England, and a moor with the gate open and walkers on it.
